events.text: Roma Mitchell was born in Adelaide, South Australia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Roma Mitchell was born in Adelaide , South Australia , on 2 October 1913

events.text: Mitchell was admitted as a barrister.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Mitchell was admitted as a barrister in 1935

events.text: Mitchell was appointed a Queens Counsel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1962 she was appointed a Queens Counsel

events.text: Mitchell was made a Justice of the Supreme Court of South Australia.
events.subject: self
events.object: Justice of the Supreme Court of South Australia
events.quote: Mitchell was made a Justice of the Supreme Court of South Australia in 1965

events.text: Mitchell was Governor of South Australia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Mitchell was Governor of South Australia from 1991 to 1996

events.text: Mitchell's term as Governor of South Australia ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Governor of South Australia from 1991 to 1996

events.text: Mitchell was Chancellor of the University of Adelaide.
events.subject: self
events.object: Chancellor of the University of Adelaide
events.quote: Chancellor of the University of Adelaide from 1983 to 1990

events.text: Mitchell's term as Chancellor of the University of Adelaide ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Chancellor of the University of Adelaide
events.quote: Chancellor of the University of Adelaide from 1983 to 1990

events.text: Mitchell was a member of the Council for the Order of Australia.
events.subject: self
events.object: Council for the Order of Australia
events.quote: was a member of the Council for the Order of Australia from 1981 to 1990

events.text: Mitchell's membership of the Council for the Order of Australia ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Council for the Order of Australia
events.quote: member of the Council for the Order of Australia from 1981 to 1990

events.text: Mitchell was appointed a Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE).
events.subject: self
events.object: Commander of the Order of the British Empire
events.quote: Mitchell was appointed a Commander of the Order of the British Empire ( CBE ) on 12 June 1971 .

events.text: She was raised to Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire (DBE).
events.subject: self
events.object: Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire
events.quote: She was raised to Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire ( DBE ) on 12 June 1982 .

events.text: Mitchell was appointed a Companion of the Order of Australia (AC).
events.subject: self
events.object: Companion of the Order of Australia
events.quote: On 26 January 1991 , Mitchell was appointed a Companion of the Order of Australia ( AC )

events.text: She was made a Commander of the Royal Victorian Order (CVO).
events.subject: self
events.object: Commander of the Royal Victorian Order
events.quote: She was made a Commander of the Royal Victorian Order ( CVO ) on 1 January 2000 .

events.text: A statue of Dame Roma in Prince Henry Gardens was erected.
events.subject: self
events.quote: A statue of Dame Roma , in Prince Henry Gardens , directly outside Government House , Adelaide , was erected in 1999 .
